4 اجرزت الأَرْضُ : see 1. ―
-b2- اجرز القَوْمُ, from أَرْضٌ جُرُزٌ, (S,) is a phrase similar to جُرُز, (S, TA,) and signifies The people journeyed in a land such as is termed جُرُز: (TA in art. يبس:) also (TA) they were, or became, afflicted with dearth, scarcity, drought, sterility, or barrenness. (K, TA.) ―
-b3- [And hence, app.,] اجرزت النَّاقَةُ The she-camel became lean, or emaciated. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
